speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Lymphoma (likely Hodgkin's or Non-Hodgkin's Lymphoma). The combination of supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, constitutional "B" symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss), and abdominal pain strongly suggests a malignant lymphoproliferative disorder. The initial blood work and CT scans will likely confirm this by showing lymphocytosis, elevated inflammatory markers, and lymphadenopathy with possible organ involvement. Further biopsy of the enlarged node is the definitive next step, but based on your presentation, lymphoma is the primary working diagnosis.
